children: Reports that Publicis Groupe secured PepsiCo's entire media account point to another major win for the French advertising group, boosting hopes that it can sustain organic revenue growth over the medium term, Bank of America analysts say. Publicis was already the incumbent for PepsiCo's media activities across many Asian markets and eastern Europe, but the win could boost its 2027 organic net revenue growth by between 50 and 100 basis points, according to Bank of America. This uplift could be reduced to between 30 and 80 basis points if Publicis loses its recently won Coca-Cola account due to the potential conflict of interest, the analysts say. Publicis shares rise 3.5%. (adria.calatayud@wsj.com)
